notes:
Tap "Try a sample board" on the first screen.

The Sample board runs the whole app on built-in sample data. It needs no GitHub account, and nothing is sent over the network. It covers:
- Board: sample people ranked for Today, 7 days and 30 days. Pull to refresh to see counts and movement change.
- People: search, filters, and hiding or showing someone with the eye button.
- Settings: Live rank, Leaderboard Notifications and About Committed.
- Share board: the share button at the top of the Board.
- Widgets: add the Committed widgets to the Home Screen or Lock Screen to see the sample board.
- Live rank: your sample rank in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen. Turn it on or off, or change its Window, in Settings > Live rank.

The Sample board stays open after a relaunch. To leave it, open Settings and tap Leave Sample Board.

A real board needs a GitHub account, connected through GitHub's device flow: tap Connect GitHub, then approve the code it shows on github.com. Committed asks for read-only access (read:user and read:org). There's no Committed account.
